objective: determine whether the positive 12Min/H12 Ridge weekly economics reflect directional information beyond same-selection long/prior-majority exposure

source.timestamp_contract: America/New_York right-close labels -> DST-aware UTC -> subtract one minute -> UTC bar start

unchanged_ridge_policy.target: future H12 MNQ point move / (current close * causal rv_120 * sqrt(12))
unchanged_ridge_policy.selection: prior-only q50 absolute normalized Ridge prediction

diagnostic_controls.same_selected_always_long: on every OOS row selected by Ridge, force +1 and keep all nonselected rows flat
diagnostic_controls.same_selected_prior_majority: on every OOS row selected by Ridge, use sign(mean prior outer-training normalized target)) and keep all nonselected rows flat
diagnostic_controls.sign_flipped_ridge: invert every selected Ridge sign as a falsification control

required_diagnostics: per-quarter raw outer prediction-target Pearson and Spearman
inner-OOF raw prediction-target Pearson and Spearman
inner-OOF selected sign accuracy and signed normalized outcome
outer selected sign accuracy and selected signed point outcome
weekly nonoverlap-phase economics for Ridge and all controls
paired weekly deltas Ridge minus same-selected always-long and prior-majority controls

directional_increment_established_only_i: Ridge absolute weekly mean > control absolute weekly mean
Ridge absolute weekly median > control absolute weekly median
interpretation_gate.if_gate_fails: do not describe current H12 Ridge economics as established directional alpha; retain only the narrower selection/drift evidence supported by the audit
interpretation_gate.if_gate_passes: directional-opportunity interpretation survives this audit but gains no promotion authority
